input.summary: Insert a new Section 14.21 requiring IBM to carry CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy and workers' compensation insurance and to provide certificates on request.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance clause even though IBM hosts our environment and processes data on our behalf, so we have added our standard coverage requirements: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, E&O of USD 2,000,000, cyber/privacy of USD 5,000,000 where IBM processes our data, workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates on request. If helpful, we can fall back to E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: Insurance. IBM shall maintain: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where IBM processes any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed on behalf of Customer, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by law. IBM shall provide certificates of insurance on request.
